## Natural history notes

A medium-sized dragonfly characterized by clear wings marked with broad dark bands, a slender body, and a perched posture often held at the tips of grasses, reeds, or twigs. In Florida, it is found around ponds, lakes, marshes, wet prairies, ditches, canals, and other sunny freshwater wetlands with emergent vegetation. Adults hunt small flying insects from exposed perches and make short flights over wetland edges, while the aquatic nymphs live among submerged plants and debris where they prey on small aquatic invertebrates.
